description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nautilus''' hurls his anchor in the target direction that stops on the first enemy or terrain hit.
description.text: Active: Nautilus hurls his anchor in the target direction that stops on the first enemy or terrain hit.

description2.raw: If the anchor hits an enemy, it deals magic damage, [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|reveals]] them for 1.15 seconds, [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stuns]] them for 1 second, and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|drags]] them toward '''Nautilus''' while he also [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] toward them, both over 0.9 seconds.
description2.text: If the anchor hits an enemy, it deals magic damage, reveals them for 1.15 seconds, stuns them for 1 second, and drags them toward Nautilus while he also dashes toward them, both over 0.9 seconds.

description3.raw: If the anchor hits terrain, '''Nautilus''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to that location and 50% of ''Dredge Line's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown and [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost are refunded.
description3.text: If the anchor hits terrain, Nautilus dashes to that location and 50% of Dredge Line's  cooldown and  mana cost are refunded.

description4.raw: '''''Nautilus''' is [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|unable]] to move or attack while Dredge Line is in flight. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''
description4.text: Nautilus is unable to move or attack while Dredge Line is in flight. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

notes.text:
Dredge Line has two hitboxes. The outer hitbox, shown by a visual effect on the ground, will hit champions edge-to-edge. The inner hitbox, shown by the anchor, can hit terrain. Near thinner walls, this can cause the ability to hit a champion on the other side.
Dredge Line turns Nautilus' facing direction accordingly upon hitting a valid target.
Dredge Line can interact with player-generated terrain.
Nautilus will dash all the way to the target's location if Dredge Line executed them or they negated the displacement.
Dredge Line will not interrupt any movement commands Nautilus was issued pre-cast so long as their directions somewhat correlate (this is intentional to smooth out traveling/escaping).
Spell shield will block the ability but Nautilus will still dash partway to the target.
The anchor projectile will stop if Nautilus dies while the projectile is traveling. Enemies hit will still be dealt damage. The drag and root are not applied if Nautilus did not initiate the dash.
Displacement immunity will not resist the application of the stun.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
